_about: Where the framework's statistics come from, and where they could. Checked by live request on the date in `checked` (Architect 2026-11-12: 'look for where you can get all the statistics'). Owned by the data analyst (.claude/agents/olp-xdv-data-analyst.md). status: in_use (a module reads it), ready (reachable, free, not read yet), key (needs a key the Architect would have to get), blocked (refuses automated reads: not used, never worked around). A new source is added here first, with what was actually seen.

sources.name: Flashscore day feed
sources.gives: every match of a day in every competition: result, 90-minute score, half-time score
sources.seen: Sunday 8 Nov 2026: 1,396 football matches in 387 competitions, half-time score on 1,361
sources.limits: only 7 days back and forward; a history has to be collected day by day

sources.name: Flashscore match feeds (stats, incidents, head-to-head)
sources.gives: about 40 team stats for the match and each half (expected goals, shots, corners, cards, fouls, possession), every goal's minute, each side's last matches and the head-to-head
sources.seen: stats tab on 20 of 40 finished matches spread across a day (corners on 18): Premier League, Argentina top flight, SAFF Championship yes; Austrian third tier no (half scores only)
sources.limits: two requests a match; one polite pass per run, never a crawl

sources.name: FotMob
sources.gives: match stats, shot map by situation, expected goals, lineups and unavailable players with market value, team season numbers with league rank, squads, coach, formation
sources.seen: read daily by the framework since October 2026
sources.limits: team news thin below the top leagues; matched to our fixtures by a strict two-name rule

sources.name: football-data.co.uk (main leagues)
sources.gives: results back 20+ seasons with half-time score, shots, shots on target, corners, fouls, cards and closing odds (1X2, over/under 2.5, Asian handicap) for 22 divisions in 11 countries
sources.seen: E0 2026-27: 100 matches with HTHG/HTAG, HC/AC, HY/AY, HF/AF, HST/AST and closing prices
sources.limits: updated twice a week; no cups

sources.name: football-data.co.uk (extra leagues)
sources.gives: results and closing 1X2 odds for 16 more countries (Argentina, Brazil, Japan, USA, Poland ...)
sources.seen: ARG.csv: 6,475 matches, full-time score and closing prices only
sources.limits: no half-time score, no corners, no cards

sources.name: ESPN public scoreboard and match summary
sources.gives: fixtures and status for 220 football competitions; per match 28 team stats (corners won, shots, fouls, cards, possession, passes, tackles) and goal minutes
sources.seen: Premier League 8 Nov 2026: summary with wonCorners, totalShots, foulsCommitted, yellowCards and a 15' goal
sources.limits: no expected goals; stats by half not given; a second source to cross-check corners and cards

sources.name: OpenLigaDB
sources.gives: German leagues (Bundesliga, 2. Bundesliga, 3. Liga, cup): every goal's minute, half-time and final score, back many seasons
sources.seen: Bundesliga matchday 9, 2026-27 and 2025-26: 9 of 9 finished, goal minutes present

sources.name: StatsBomb open data
sources.gives: event-by-event data (every pass, shot with expected goals, pressure) for chosen competitions
sources.limits: historic and selective, not a live feed: for studying methods, not for daily numbers

sources.name: football-data.org
sources.cost: free key (12 competitions, 10 requests a minute)
sources.gives: fixtures, results with half-time score, scorers, standings
sources.seen: competition list answers without a key (192 listed); match data needs the key
sources.limits: top competitions only on the free plan

sources.name: API-Football
sources.cost: free key (100 requests a day, old seasons only)
sources.gives: 1,100+ competitions: fixtures, events with minutes, team stats, lineups, odds
sources.seen: status call refuses without a key; the framework holds a free key used for history only
sources.limits: free plan serves seasons 2022-2024, so it is two years behind; current seasons are paid

sources.name: Understat
sources.gives: expected goals and every shot with its minute for the big five leagues and Russia
sources.seen: page answers (200) but the embedded data was not found on the 2026 page: its layout has changed
sources.limits: six leagues; needs a new reader before it can be trusted; Flashscore and FotMob already give xG

sources.name: ClubElo
sources.gives: club ratings by date for European leagues
sources.seen: 502 (server error) at the time of the check
sources.limits: Europe only; was down when checked

sources.name: TheSportsDB
sources.gives: fixtures and results for many sports
sources.seen: the results call refused the public test key (403) on the day of the check
sources.limits: match statistics are behind its paid tier

sources.name: Sofascore
sources.gives: match statistics by half, incidents, player ratings, wide coverage

sources.name: FBref
sources.gives: season and match tables by competition

sources.name: SoccerSTATS
sources.gives: league tables of goal times, both-teams-to-score, half-time and corner numbers (the kind of ranking in the videos)

sources.name: FootyStats
sources.gives: both-teams-to-score, corners, first-half and goals-by-minute tables for 1,500+ leagues
sources.seen: 403 with a browser check page; it sells a data API
sources.limits: refuses automated reads; a paid plan would be the Architect's decision
